curriculum_notes: Each session is an interactive AI-tutored session (30-40 min) following the structure: prior-knowledge activation -> framework taught through agri-finance examples -> teach-back in user's own words -> live application to a real CRM contact -> concepts pushed to drill bank with FSRS scheduling. Sessions unlock sequentially. Completing a session seeds its drillable concepts into the review queue.

sessions.title: The Trust Equation
sessions.application_prompt: Score yourself on C, R, I, S for your top-priority referrer. Which component is weakest and what one action this fortnight raises it?

sessions.title: The Five-Stage Trust Conversation
sessions.application_prompt: Take your next booked client meeting. Draft an Engage opener and predict what the 'real issue' behind the stated issue might be.

sessions.title: The Relationship Ladder & Trust Behaviours
sessions.application_prompt: Tag five CRM relationships with their current ladder rung and define the next-rung action for each.

sessions.title: The Four Stages & Question Types
sessions.application_prompt: For an upcoming meeting, list the situation questions you'd normally ask and convert as many as possible into pre-meeting research.

sessions.title: Implication Questions — the Core Skill
sessions.application_prompt: Pick a live deal. Write the client's three implied needs and one implication question for each that grows its seriousness.

sessions.title: Need-Payoff & Demonstrating Capability
sessions.application_prompt: Rewrite your standard Macquarie capability pitch: strip features, map each capability to an explicit need from a real client as a benefit.

sessions.title: Advances, Commitment & Objection Prevention
sessions.application_prompt: Write best-case and minimum-acceptable advances for your next three scheduled interactions, including referrer coffees.

sessions.title: Reciprocity, Liking & Social Proof
sessions.application_prompt: Design a give-first item for each of your top three referrers, and start a de-identified case-story log entry matching a real client's region/commodity.

sessions.title: Authority, Scarcity & Commitment
sessions.application_prompt: Find one live situation where the honest advice is 'don't move yet' — and deliver it. Log what it does to the relationship.

sessions.title: Unity & the Defence Module
sessions.application_prompt: Identify the unity assets you genuinely share with three key contacts. Then audit one incumbent-bank retention offer a client showed you: which levers is it pulling?

sessions.title: Fundamentals & Being Liked
sessions.application_prompt: Before your next meeting, load: every personal name (kids, dog, property), one specific true appreciation, and a 70/30 listening target.

sessions.title: Winning People Over & Saving Face
sessions.application_prompt: Map one succession conversation: where can the structure become 'the family's idea'? Whose face must be protected, and how?

sessions.title: Network Architecture & Generosity
sessions.application_prompt: Audit your CRM cadence: what is your touches-without-ask ratio for the top 10? Assign a relationship glue to each.

sessions.title: Super-Connectors, Your NAP & Personal Brand
sessions.application_prompt: Flag the super-connectors in your 63 contacts. Write your two-sentence unique message. Draft your first 90-day NAP cycle.

sessions.title: Tactical Empathy: Mirrors, Labels & the Accusation Audit
sessions.application_prompt: Write the accusation audit for your next first meeting with a new referrer — the three worst things they could think about a Macquarie banker — and one label you expect to need. Then mirror-drill: take the last hard thing a client said to you and write the three-word mirror.

sessions.title: Calibrated Questions & the Retention Counter-Offer
sessions.application_prompt: Take a live deal where the incumbent bank will counter. Script: the label for the counter-offer moment, two calibrated questions, and your range-anchored rate framing. List the black swans you suspect but haven't confirmed.

sessions.title: Commercial Insight & Beating Indecision (JOLT)
sessions.application_prompt: Pick your stalest live opportunity. Diagnose: status-quo problem or indecision (FOMU)? Write either the reframe that busts the status quo, or the recommendation + safety net + start-small path that de-risks the decision.

sessions.title: Integration Capstone
sessions.application_prompt: Expert roleplay: Helen Brandt succession scenario, full conversation, graded across all seven frameworks simultaneously. Pass mark unlocks 'Integrated' rank.
